title.zh: 美国银行家协会不满OCC最终《GENIUS法案》规则放弃拟议的稳定币收益限制
title.en: 美国银行家协会不满OCC最终《GENIUS法案》规则放弃拟议的稳定币收益限制

current_state.zh: The OCC's final GENIUS Act rule abandons proposed restrictions on stablecoin yield, prompting the American Bankers Association to warn that the decision preserves crypto platforms' current advantages and risks bank deposit outflows.
current_state.en: The OCC's final GENIUS Act rule abandons proposed restrictions on stablecoin yield, prompting the American Bankers Association to warn that the decision preserves crypto platforms' current advantages and risks bank deposit outflows.
